text:
talia-ae: Heads up: Cascade wants a 3-week POC for invoice ingestion + downstream QA + a lightweight reconciliation mock. They asked for a clear eval playbook, security checklist, and a comparator metric set. Can we agree on gates/timeline/pricing now?

anita-se: summary of use cases: 1) parse invoices into structured fields, 2) answer ad-hoc questions over docs, 3) flag mismatches vs mocked purchase orders for reconciliation.

jon-ml: for the harness I propose: golden set = 140 redacted invoices (varied vendors), 40 synthetic edge cases (rotated scans, low-res), and 200 regression samples. Metrics: per-field token F1, exact match for invoice_id, and reconciliation precision/recall on matched line items.

omar-infra: perf baseline: target p95 <= 300ms for extraction at 12 QPS with ~450 tokens. Hosted can meet it with reserved throughput; Dedicated micro (2xA10G) recommended for consistent latency. eu-central region available.

sandra-legal: they asked about model training restrictions. We'll state: no customer data will be used to train public models. Addendum for data processing + deletion SLA (30 days). Need to confirm whether they require a certified DPA template.

maya-sec: minimal security checklist to proceed with sample upload: allowlist CIDRs, SFTP or encrypted S3 presigned, confirm presence of PHI/PII, retention window, and BYOK requirement. If they require HSM or annual pen test, that escalates timeline.

talia-ae: Customer wants success gates that are straightforward to present to their execs. Thoughts from eng?

anita-se: simple gates: (A) Extraction: per-field F1 >= 0.88 on golden; (B) QA: human-eval pass-rate >= 84% on 120 queries; (C) Reconciliation: line-item match precision >= 90% on reconc test; (D) Latency: p95 <= 350ms in designated env; (E) Security: checklist items answered and no high-risk findings.

jon-ml: regression policy: nightly harness comparing new model to baseline. Alert if per-field F1 delta <= -0.035 absolute. Blocked for release if reconciliation precision drops > 0.05 absolute. Auto-rollback only for severe production regressions (F1 drop > 0.06).

omar-infra: quick pricing sketches for 3-week POC: hosted metered approx $6k-9k depending on usage spikes; Dedicated prorated commit ~ $4k-6k plus a short infra setup fee. I'll run a sim and post details.

sandra-legal: also confirm whether Cascade requires data residency in eu-central specifically or just EU. If strict, Dedicated or Private recommended.

maya-sec: add to checklist: enable audit log forwarding to their SIEM, and confirm whether single-tenant key management required.

anita-se: golden prompt example (JSON-only outputs) — please use this as the seed for annotators:```
SYSTEM: You are an invoice parsing assistant. Extract fields: invoice_number, date, total_amount, vendor_name, billing_address, line_items [{description, quantity, unit_price}]. Return strictly valid JSON.
USER: <raw_OCR_or_text>
ASSISTANT: {"invoice_number":"","date":"","total_amount":"","vendor_name":"","billing_address":"","line_items":[]}
```

jon-ml: for human eval we will pair 6 annotators to label Q&A responses and reconciliation matches; store labels and model outputs in harness to compute inter-annotator agreement and confidence intervals.

talia-ae: timeline proposal they accepted tentatively: Week0 (data intake + sec checklist answers), Week1 (golden set + baseline runs), Week2 (model iterations + infra tune), Week3 (nightly regressions + human eval + final report). They asked for kickoff Monday.

omar-infra: can commit if we receive 60 redacted samples + CIDRs by Tue noon. I'll reserve eu-central capacity and post a cost sim by EOD.

sandra-legal: I'll prepare a minimal DPA + data usage summary and flag any clauses that need negotiation.

maya-sec: I'll circulate the short checklist to Cascade and be on the call. Pen test request warned it could add ~3 weeks.

devops-bot: staging env cascade-poc available at https://staging.cascade.redwood.internal — credentials in 1Password.

talia-ae: next steps: 1) I send aligned SOW + minimal DPA + sample request to Cascade (today). 2) omar posts cost sim + region capacity (EOD). 3) anita/jon finalize golden set format and annotator schema (Mon). 4) maya/sandra follow up on security & legal items (today).

anita-se: we'll also set up Console dashboards with per-field F1, reconciliation precision, and latency by route.

talia-ae: great work team. I'll close this thread after kickoff scheduling. :thumbsup:
